primary_diagnosis_treated: Metabolic syndrome‑driven early type 2 diabetes with hypertension
nice_guideline_used: NG28 (Type 2 diabetes management), NG136 (Hypertension), CG181 (Cardiovascular risk & dyslipidaemia)

medications.dose: Start 500 mg PO once daily with evening meal; increase by 500 mg every 3‑5 days as tolerated to max 2000 mg daily
medications.purpose: Improve insulin sensitivity and lower HbA1c; first‑line oral therapy for type 2 diabetes
medications.nice_justification: NG28 (2024 update) recommends Metformin + SGLT2‑i as dual first‑line therapy for all adults with type 2 diabetes

medications.purpose: Additive glucose‑lowering, weight loss, renal and cardiovascular protection
medications.nice_justification: NG28 (2024 update) recommends adding an SGLT2‑i at initiation of diabetes therapy

medications.dose: Start 2.5 mg PO once daily; after 2 weeks increase to 5 mg, then to 10 mg to achieve BP < 140/90 mmHg (or <130/80 mmHg if albuminuria)
medications.purpose: Control stage 1 hypertension and provide renal protection in diabetes
medications.nice_justification: NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive in patients with diabetes or CKD

medications.purpose: Primary prevention of ASCVD given low HDL and elevated cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: CG181 advises a statin for adults with QRISK ≥ 10 % or metabolic‑syndrome components

interactions_checked.interaction: Potential for mild tachycardia from β2‑agonist; ACE‑I may cause cough or hypotension
interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure and cough; counsel patient to report persistent cough

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – NICE NG28 requires eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² before starting Metformin; assume eGFR ≥45 mL/min/1.73 m² but order serum creatinine/eGFR before initiation.
Liver function tests not available – required before starting a statin; assume normal LFTs but obtain baseline ALT/AST.
Full lipid profile (LDL, total cholesterol) missing – needed to confirm ASCVD risk; assume elevated enough to merit moderate‑intensity statin.
Blood pressure readings not recorded – assume stage 1 hypertension (140‑149/90‑99 mmHg); obtain measurements on two occasions before final titration.
QRISK score not calculated – NICE CG181 uses QRISK ≥ 10 % for statin initiation; assume risk is ≥10 % given metabolic‑syndrome components.
Allergy status to ACE‑I, statin, or Metformin not documented – verify patient has no known drug allergies before prescribing.
History of recurrent urinary‑tract or genital infections not reported – counsel patient on SGLT2‑i infection risk.
treatment_summary: Initiate dual first‑line diabetes therapy with Metformin XR (titrated to 2 g) and dapagliflozin 10 mg daily, start ACE‑I ramipril for hypertension and renal protection, and begin atorvastatin 20 mg for primary cardiovascular prevention. All choices follow NICE NG28, NG136 and CG181 recommendations. Baseline labs (eGFR, ACR, LFTs, lipids, potassium) and BP measurements are required before finalising doses. Provide structured lifestyle education (DESMOND/NHS DPP), Mediterranean diet, 150 min/week exercise, and smoking cessation support. Review BP in 2 weeks, Metformin titration in 4 weeks, and repeat HbA1c, lipids and renal function at 3 months; thereafter annual review.
